widget.prompt: Build an array with 6 rows of 7.

cml.actionGoal: Manipulate the model and track how it represents six-times facts.
invariants: The manipulated model and the mathematical relationship for six-times facts must stay consistent.
misconceptions: Changing a visible feature without preserving the relationship that defines six-times facts.
cml.counterfactualPrompt: What change would make the model stop representing the same mathematical relationship?

explanationVariants: 6 × 7 = 42 — one of the table facts worth knowing on sight.

commonErrors.feedback: That is 6 short of the product — one whole group of 6 is missing.
